topography.project_purpose: BEND is a decentralized lending protocol that enables users to supply and borrow assets using isolated markets and adaptive interest rate curves. It integrates with Morpho Blue for efficient lending markets and includes governance, staking, and NFT components.
topography.relationship_narrative: The BEND lending family relies on Morpho Blue and its own adaptive curve IRM, while governance controls parameters across lending and proof-of-liquidity. Proof-of-liquidity contracts distribute incentives in BGT and Honey tokens, which are also used in staking and Balancer pools for liquidity.
